title: General
headline: Give General one job: app setup.
diagnosis: Six unrelated groups compete here. A live Interact switch sits beside onboarding, Stream Deck, permissions, screenshots and startup.
changes: Move Interact back to the controls used while presenting. Move hand visibility to Effects and Stream Deck to Controls.
Replace the two screenshot switches with one choice: Save and copy, Save to folder, or Copy to clipboard.
Use permission names and explicit status. Put automatic and manual updates together, with an honest state for builds without updates.
inventory: Menu bar / toolbar / Quick controls; assign its key in Controls → Keyboard
Stream Deck installer, host requirements, install status
General → Permissions; relevant feature shows a recovery link

title: Shortcuts
headline: Make assignments easy to find.
diagnosis: Roughly 26 command rows repeat Unassigned. Instructions for the radial menu, gesture artwork and drawing behavior interrupt the list.
changes: Use four focused views: Keyboard, Quick controls, Toolbar and Stream Deck.
Group keyboard commands by Pointer, Drawing and Presenting. Search all commands; keep assigned and conflicted groups open.
Put a conflict summary above the list. Keep the essential scope rule visible; move the radial tutorial into Practice.

Clear, Undo / Redo Annotation, Match Ink to Pointer
Pen, Rectangle, Arrow, Text, Number, Eraser, Highlighter
Screenshot, Capture Region, Magnification, Toolbar, Settings
Hold-to-open modifier and Open Quick controls key
Clear assignments, recording errors, key conflicts
Each assignment field; conflict summary at top
Controls → Quick controls → Practice / How it works

title: Drawing
headline: Start with the result, then tune the ink.
diagnosis: Selected tool is presented as a preference above the practice canvas. Color, stroke and lifetime settings are separated even though they shape the same annotation.
changes: Put a local practice canvas first, with its own tool strip. Use it to demonstrate width, color, opacity and fading.
Keep Color, Line width, Opacity and Fading visible. Show a fade delay only when it applies.
Put smoothing and trail tuning in Advanced. The live desktop tool remains available in the menu bar, toolbar and shortcuts.
inventory: Live toolbar / menu / Quick controls / keys; local practice has its own selector
Drawing preview, background, clear local sample
Drawing → Fading, visible for Fade and Trail

title: Pointers
headline: Choose first. Customize when asked.
diagnosis: Toolbar pins, a nested scrolling library, several buttons on every tile, per-pointer overrides and gesture artwork all stack on one page.
changes: Use a current-pointer header, one search field and one Filter menu. Keep combined Enabled, Pinned and Custom filters inside that menu.
Click a tile to select it. Put enable, pin and removal commands in a visible actions menu, also available by keyboard and context menu.
Open per-pointer Look, Sound and Gestures in Customize. Show Restore Default only beside a changed value. Open New Hand as a sheet.
inventory: Toolbar favorites, reorder, unpin, add, reset
Controls → Toolbar → Favorites; Pointers has an Edit Favorites link

Search; combined Enabled / Pinned / Custom filters

Size, shadow, sound overrides and per-field Use Default

Describe, copy prompt / open ChatGPT, import, validate, name, add
Separate pointer browser from Quick controls
Keep the focused chooser, reuse library content and filter behavior

title: Appearance
headline: Put every pointer default together.
diagnosis: Appearance mixes app theme, pointer defaults, motion, magnification and the floating toolbar. Sound contains the other half of the same defaults.
changes: Rename the page Effects. Bring shared tap sound and app volume here. Move app theme to General and toolbar configuration to Controls.
Keep a scoped preview above the common controls. Label it Shared defaults so overrides cannot make the preview misleading.
Replace Shadow on/off plus a disabled style picker with Off / Original / Contact. Put lens settings and motion tuning in named disclosures.
inventory: Shared pointer size, shadow visibility, shadow style
Keep hand visible while interacting, from General
Shared sound and master output, from Sound

title: Sound
headline: Sound belongs with the pointer defaults.
diagnosis: A small standalone page splits default sound from default appearance. Choosing a sound, previewing it and enabling it take separate rows, followed by another status-only row.
changes: Combine default tap sound, sound choice and preview in one compact group inside Effects.
Keep Mute all sounds and app volume distinct from per-pointer tap-sound choices. A preview respects master mute and volume.
Explain overrides beside the selected pointer. Restore one sound value without clearing unrelated custom settings.
inventory: Master mute and app output volume
Default tap sound enabled and sound choice
Inline Preview button, disabled with a visible reason when muted
Per-pointer enabled and sound choice overrides
Pointers → Customize → Sound; independent Restore Default actions

title: Presets
headline: Show the saved setup before applying it.
diagnosis: A name field, popup and action row obscure the actual saved setups. The summary exposes a pointer ID, and recovery exposes a filesystem path.
changes: Show named setups as a list with a pointer thumbnail and human-readable summary. Open naming only when saving a new preset.
Keep Import and Export together. Preserve the full import review, conflict checks and persistent recovery.
Move Reset All Settings here from About. Use Show Recovery Folder in place of printing the path.
inventory: Save named setup; apply, update, remove
Presets & Backup → Saved presets and row actions
Selected pointer ID, pin and disabled counts
Preset summary using pointer names and readable counts
Included/excluded data, import preview, conflict refusal
Backup → What is included; full Import review sheet
Missing pointer / artwork fallback, preserved overrides
Persistent Undo Last Change and recovery folder
Transaction banner with Undo; Show Recovery Folder
Presets & Backup → Reset, retaining current confirmation / recovery behavior

title: About
headline: Let About be about the app.
diagnosis: Credits share a page with update actions and a destructive reset. Neither belongs to the identity of the app.
changes: Keep the app icon, exact product name, version/build and author together.
Keep GitHub, TinyHand attribution, MIT license and open-source notices as ordinary links.
Move update controls to General and Reset All Settings to Presets & Backup.
